description: This file defines a FastAPI application with a dependency class for query parameters and a GET endpoint to retrieve items with optional query filtering and pagination.

classes.name: CommonQueryParams
classes.description: A dependency class that encapsulates common query parameters such as 'q' for search query, 'skip' for pagination offset, and 'limit' for pagination size.

methods.name: <init>
methods.description: Constructor for CommonQueryParams, initializing query, skip, and limit parameters with default values.

methods.name: read_items(commons: Annotated[Any, Depends(CommonQueryParams)])
methods.description: Asynchronous GET endpoint that retrieves items from the fake database, filters them based on query parameters, and supports pagination.
